title: Conditional expectation plan construction
statement: Let $D$ be a finite, nonempty label set, and let an input be a finite randomized constraint satisfaction problem on $n$ variables with a marginal label law for each variable. Its conditional expectation plan is the plan whose assignment and work are those produced by the input's local controller.
caveat: The referenced local controller is not defined in the supplied statement, so its behavior cannot be described more specifically.
